_help: Brifing za aerodrom u aplikaciji „Aerodrom“. Tekstovi na en/sr (de koristi en). Samo činjenice sa važećih karata, sopstvenim rečima; za simulaciju letenja. Izmeni na GitHubu kad se karte promene.
name: Belgrade Nikola Tesla

source.en: From the aerodrome charts and airport briefing of LYBE, effective 9 July 2026. For flight simulation only – always check your current charts.
source.sr: Prema kartama aerodroma i brifingu za LYBE, važe od 9. jula 2026. Samo za simulaciju letenja – uvek proveri važeće karte.

12L.en: Turn right onto RWY 30L without stopping, hold on 12R/30L before D5.
12L.sr: Skreni desno na RWY 30L bez zaustavljanja, čekaj na 12R/30L pre D5.

12L.en: Cross RWY 12R/30L without stopping, join D6, then A; hold at intermediate holding position A3.
12L.sr: Pređi RWY 12R/30L bez zaustavljanja, D6 pa A; čekaj na međuposlu A3.

12L.en: Cross RWY 12R/30L without stopping, join D7 and hold.
12L.sr: Pređi RWY 12R/30L bez zaustavljanja, uđi na D7 i čekaj.

30R.en: Turn right onto RWY 30L without stopping, hold on 12R/30L before D5.
30R.sr: Skreni desno na RWY 30L bez zaustavljanja, čekaj na 12R/30L pre D5.

30R.en: Turn right onto RWY 30L without stopping, hold on 12R/30L before D3. Mind D3 and D4 (hot spot HS1).
30R.sr: Skreni desno na RWY 30L bez zaustavljanja, čekaj na 12R/30L pre D3. Pazi na D3 i D4 (HS1).

30R.en: Enter RWY 12R/30L and hold on it before D3.
30R.sr: Uđi na RWY 12R/30L i čekaj na njoj pre D3.

30R.en: Cross RWY 12R/30L without stopping, join D1 and hold.
30R.sr: Pređi RWY 12R/30L bez zaustavljanja, uđi na D1 i čekaj.

items.en: RWY 12L/30R is the runway in use. 12R/30L is used only when 12L/30R is closed (maintenance or incident, by NOTAM) – it cannot be requested.
items.sr: U upotrebi je RWY 12L/30R. 12R/30L se koristi samo kad je 12L/30R zatvorena (radovi ili incident, NOTAM) – ne može se tražiti.

items.en: The two runways are never used at the same time: they are too close to each other.
items.sr: Dve piste se nikad ne koriste istovremeno – previše su blizu.

items.en: While 12L/30R is in use, 12R/30L is a taxi route. Arrivals taxi beyond the CAT III holding position and may enter or cross 12R/30L without a clearance; departures need no clearance to enter or cross it for take-off from 12L/30R.
items.sr: Dok je 12L/30R u upotrebi, 12R/30L je rulna staza. Dolasci rule iza CAT III mesta čekanja i ulaze ili prelaze 12R/30L bez odobrenja; polasci ne trebaju odobrenje za ulazak ili prelazak radi poletanja sa 12L/30R.

items.en: CAT II/III approaches: RWY 12L and 12R (approved crew and aircraft only).
items.sr: CAT II/III prilazi: RWY 12L i 12R (samo sertifikovana posada i avion).

items.en: LVP when the RVR at touchdown or mid-point is below 550 m and/or the cloud base or vertical visibility is below 200 ft. ATC says “LVP in force”.
items.sr: LVP kad je RVR u TDZ ili sredini ispod 550 m i/ili baza oblaka ili vertikalna vidljivost ispod 200 ft. Kontrola javlja „LVP in force“.

items.en: Guided low visibility take-off: RWY 12L, 12R and 30R.
items.sr: Vođeno poletanje pri smanjenoj vidljivosti: RWY 12L, 12R i 30R.

items.en: After an LVP approach vacate 12L via E or 12R via D7. Report landed, and “runway vacated” at the end of the yellow-green taxiway centreline lights.
items.sr: Posle LVP prilaza napusti 12L preko E ili 12R preko D7. Javi sletanje i „runway vacated“ na kraju žuto-zelenih svetala ose rulne staze.

items.en: RVR below 350 m: taxi only where there are taxiway lights. No left turn from H onto K or J, no right turn from J or K onto H.
items.sr: RVR ispod 350 m: rulaj samo gde ima svetala. Zabranjeno levo sa H na K ili J i desno sa J ili K na H.

items.en: Take-off minima: 125 m (with LVP, centreline lights 15 m or less), 150 m (with LVP), 300 m (with LVP, edge lights); without LVP 400 m by day with edge or centreline lights, 500 m by day with adequate visual reference – not at night.
items.sr: Minimumi za poletanje: 125 m (LVP, svetla ose na 15 m ili manje), 150 m (LVP), 300 m (LVP, ivična svetla); bez LVP 400 m danju sa ivičnim ili svetlima ose, 500 m danju uz dovoljnu vizuelnu referencu – noću ne.

items.en: TWY E: no left turn from RWY 30R for aircraft with an outer main gear wheel span above 9 m.
items.sr: TWY E: zabranjeno levo sa RWY 30R za avione sa rasponom glavnog stajnog trapa većim od 9 m.

items.en: TWY G between stands A11 and A15 (stands included): wingspan up to 36 m. Abeam E1–E4 and A11–A15 use minimum power.
items.sr: TWY G između pozicija A11 i A15 (i same pozicije): raspon krila do 36 m. Pored E1–E4 i A11–A15 minimalna snaga.

items.en: With an A346, A351, B773 or B77W on C3A, C5A, C7A, C9A or C11A, TWY F behind that stand is limited to a wingspan of 52 m.
items.sr: Kad A346, A351, B773 ili B77W stoji na C3A, C5A, C7A, C9A ili C11A, TWY F iza te pozicije je za raspon do 52 m.

items.en: TWY L between the service road on apron B and the maintenance ramp: wingspan up to 60.3 m.
items.sr: TWY L od servisnog puta na platformi B do platforme za održavanje: raspon do 60,3 m.

items.en: Stand N1 occupied: TWY T between stop bar F4 and stand C14 is for wingspans up to 36 m; with N1A occupied it is closed.
items.sr: Kad je N1 zauzeta: TWY T između stop bara F4 i pozicije C14 za raspon do 36 m; kad je N1A zauzeta – zatvorena.

items.en: A follow-me car helps when you are not sure of your position, after a failure on the manoeuvring area, or with lost communication.
items.sr: Follow-me vozilo pomaže kad nisi siguran gde si, posle kvara na manevarskim površinama ili bez veze.

items.en: Report on stand before engine shut-down. Keep radio contact with ATC whenever you are outside a stand.
items.sr: Javi se na poziciji pre gašenja motora. Van pozicije uvek budi na vezi sa kontrolom.

items.en: Docking guidance (VDGS): A1–A10 and C1–C14. Marshaller: A11–A15, GA1–GA3, B1–B10, B1A, B9A, C3A, C5A, N1, N1A, N2, E1–E4, E1A, E2A, W1, W1A, W2.
items.sr: Navođenje (VDGS): A1–A10 i C1–C14. Maršaler: A11–A15, GA1–GA3, B1–B10, B1A, B9A, C3A, C5A, N1, N1A, N2, E1–E4, E1A, E2A, W1, W1A, W2.

items.en: Self-manoeuvring: GA1–GA3; B1 and E1 (turn right), B2–B9 and E2 (left or right) when the next stand is free; E3 and E4 under conditions. All other stands need a push-back.
items.sr: Samostalno manevrisanje: GA1–GA3; B1 i E1 (desno), B2–B9 i E2 (levo ili desno) kad je susedna pozicija slobodna; E3 i E4 uz uslove. Sve ostale pozicije – push-back.

items.en: C11A: push-back facing west. Wide-bodies from C3A/C5A face stop bar F1. From E1A or B9A: push onto TWY H facing E1, then minimum power via L, J or K to G. From E2A: push onto TWY G facing south, then minimum power via L, J or K to H.
items.sr: C11A: push-back sa nosom na zapad. Široki avioni sa C3A/C5A licem ka stop baru F1. Sa E1A ili B9A: na TWY H licem ka E1, pa minimalnom snagom preko L, J ili K na G. Sa E2A: na TWY G licem na jug, pa preko L, J ili K na H.

items.en: A11–A15 and GA1–GA3 are not used at the same time. GA1–GA3 with LVP: taxi out only with a marshaller.
items.sr: A11–A15 i GA1–GA3 se ne koriste istovremeno. GA1–GA3 pri LVP: izlazak samo uz maršalera.

items.en: Squawk 7600. Keep the last assigned level for 7 minutes or until you join the holding, whichever is later.
items.sr: Squawk 7600. Zadrži poslednji dodeljeni nivo 7 minuta ili do ulaska u holding, šta je kasnije.

items.en: No runway and STAR assigned: fly to the first waypoint of the STAR in your flight plan, hold there and descend to 10 000 ft. Choose the runway by ATIS (else by the last wind; if suitable, the closer one). Then fly to LABUD (12L), LAMBA (12R) or TUPKO (30L and 30R), hold there, descend to the MHA and fly the approach.
items.sr: Bez dodeljene piste i STAR-a: leti do prve tačke STAR-a iz plana leta, uđi u holding i spusti se na 10 000 ft. Pistu biraj po ATIS-u (inače po poslednjem vetru; ako odgovara, bližu). Zatim LABUD (12L), LAMBA (12R) ili TUPKO (30L i 30R), holding, spuštanje na MHA i prilaz.

items.en: STAR assigned, not yet on it: hold at its first waypoint, descend to the MHA, then fly the whole STAR and the approach.
items.sr: Dodeljen STAR, još nisi na njemu: holding na prvoj tački, spuštanje na MHA, pa ceo STAR i prilaz.

items.en: Already on the STAR or vectored: keep the last level, follow the STAR (or as cleared), hold at LABUD, LAMBA or TUPKO, descend to the MHA and fly the approach.
items.sr: Već na STAR-u ili pod vektorisanjem: zadrži nivo, prati STAR (ili odobrenje), holding na LABUD, LAMBA ili TUPKO, MHA i prilaz.

items.en: Birds in the vicinity of the airport.
items.sr: Ptice u blizini aerodroma.

hotspots.en: High-volume intersection for all traffic to and from both runways; vehicles cross here too. Vacating 12L/30R at R4: do not mix up D3 and D4.
hotspots.sr: Prometna raskrsnica za sav saobraćaj ka i sa obe piste; ovde prelaze i vozila. Napuštanje 12L/30R preko R4: ne mešaj D3 i D4.

hotspots.en: High-volume intersection for all traffic to and from both runways; vehicles cross here too.
hotspots.sr: Prometna raskrsnica za sav saobraćaj ka i sa obe piste; ovde prelaze i vozila.

hotspots.en: Busy intersection where a service road crosses TWY L – watch for ground vehicles, towed aircraft and aircraft leaving stand B10.
hotspots.sr: Prometna raskrsnica gde servisni put prelazi TWY L – pazi na vozila, vučene avione i avione sa pozicije B10.

hotspots.en: Complex taxiway intersection – taxi with care.
